name: Delirium Family Guide, taken from the book cover
principle: The website is designed to look like the book: the cover's teal field and central light, gold title capitals, then paper pages set like the printed book. Delirium Support shares the teal, gold and serif headings but stays a free information site with no commercial look.

usage.gold: Title capitals, ornaments and buttons on dark teal. Not for small text on paper; use bronze there.
usage.gold_light: Small or medium gold text on teal, for contrast.
usage.paper: Main reading background. Book excerpts sit on the lighter page colour with the book's drop cap and small capitals.
usage.contrast: Body text meets WCAG AA. Gold on night teal 5.6:1; ink on paper 14.5:1; bronze on paper 6.2:1.

typography.serif: EB Garamond (self-hosted, variable weight 400 to 800, roman and italic, small caps and old-style figures kept)
typography.rule: Serif for anything the book would print; sans for navigation, labels, forms and small print.

ornament: The divider from the cover (line, diamonds, ring and dot, diamonds, line) is an SVG symbol reused between sections.
